_comment: Edit the expID lists and run knobs here, then pass this file with --config.
_demo_comment: Set demo_spec to a JSON object or a path to another JSON file if you want custom synthetic demo data.

_field_help.user_id: Your lab user folder name. The script uses it to resolve the default repository root at /home/<user_id>/data/Repository.
_field_help.repo_base: Base repository path. Keep this if your data lives in the standard lab layout; otherwise point it at a different repository root.
_field_help.movie_expids: List every movie experiment to analyze. Put one expID per line/item in the YYYY-MM-DD_NN_ANIMAL format.
_field_help.sleep_expids: List every sleep experiment to analyze. These are processed with sleep_state.pickle only, and the anatomical compartment is inherited from the same-day source when available.
_field_help.basal_expids: Subset of movie_expids that should be treated as basal dendrite experiments.
_field_help.apical_expids: Subset of movie_expids that should be treated as apical dendrite experiments.
_field_help.state_mode: Primary state-selection mode. Use all, quiet, or active. For sleep experiments this controls the sleep labels to compare; for movie experiments it is combined with movie_trial_types to build the comparison list.
_field_help.movie_trial_types: Explicit movie trial types to include in the comparison list. Use any subset of blank, grating, zebra, and movies. Movie experiments should set this field explicitly.
_field_help.compare_states: Legacy compatibility shortcut. It can still fill both state_comparison_states and basal_apical_states, but the explicit state_mode and movie_trial_types fields are the primary path now.
_field_help.state_comparison_states: Optional manual override for the pairwise state comparison analysis. If you set this, it wins over the derived state_mode/movie_trial_types selection.
_field_help.basal_apical_states: Optional list of state labels for the basal-vs-apical analysis. The default set is the movie states, but sleep labels such as quiet_awake, nrem, and rem are also allowed when matching sleep expIDs exist in the cache.
_field_help.channel: Suite2p channel index to load from recordings/s2p_ch<channel>.pickle. Use 0 unless your data were saved on another channel.
_field_help.shuffle_n: Number of shuffle iterations used for null distributions in the statistical tests. Increase for more stable p-values.
_field_help.cpu_thread_limit: Maximum number of native CPU threads allowed for NumPy, SciPy, and statsmodels work. Set 1 to keep the pipeline single-threaded.
_field_help.high_pass_hz: High-pass cutoff applied to the dF/F traces before robust regression and correlation analysis.
_field_help.locomotion_threshold: Wheel-speed threshold used to split movie trials into quiet_* and active_* states. Leave this null if you want the script to prefer the value stored in sleep_state.pickle when it exists; otherwise the config value wins.
_field_help.rebuild: Set true to ignore any existing cache and rebuild everything from the raw files.
_field_help.source_cache_rebuild: Set true to rebuild only the source cache from raw experiments, while still allowing other caches to reload if they are valid.
_field_help.analysis_tables_rebuild: Set true to rebuild only the reusable analysis-table cache.
_field_help.analysis_results_rebuild: Set true to rebuild only the derived analysis-results cache.
_field_help.shared_shuffle_cache_rebuild: Set true to rebuild only the shared shuffle/null cache used by the statistical tests.
_field_help.output_dir: Directory where analysis_results.json, CSV tables, and the cache will be written. Set null to use the script default, which is the results/main_pipeline folder under codex_analysis.
_field_help.cache_path: Exact path for the compressed NumPy cache. Set null to let the script place it inside output_dir/cache.
_field_help.analysis_tables_cache_path: Exact path for the cached reusable analysis tables. Set null to let the script derive a sibling file from cache_path.
_field_help.analysis_results_cache_path: Exact path for the cached derived analysis results. Set null to let the script derive a sibling file from cache_path.
_field_help.demo_spec: Keep null for real-data runs. For synthetic demos, point this at a demo-spec JSON file or embed a demo-spec object here.
_field_help.fit_spine_coactivity_mixed_model: Set true to enable the optional mixed-model inference layer for spine coactivity. Leave false to keep the pairwise coactivity tables, summaries, and heatmaps only.
_field_help.spine_coactivity_only: Set true to skip the main state/correlation/matrix analyses and run only spine coactivity from the cache. This matches the --spine-coactivity-only CLI flag.
_field_help.spine_coactivity_anchor_state: Anchor state used to build the quiet-awake-movies spine-coactivity pair plots and related summaries. Use quiet_awake_movies for the requested coactive-pair figures.
_field_help.spine_coactivity_abs_threshold: Absolute coactivity cutoff used for quiet-awake-movies anchor selection. Quiet-anchor downstream analyses keep pairs with shuffle_significant=true and abs(coactivity_r) at or above this threshold.
_field_help.source_cache_validate: Set false to skip the expensive source-cache recheck and reuse the cached source experiments directly when the cache metadata matches. This matches --skip-source-cache-validation.
_field_help.mixed_model_contrast_p_source: Choose the p-value source for mixed-model contrasts. Use classical for the model p-values or shuffle to restore shuffle-refit p-values. This controls both mixed-model branches and the optional spine-coactivity mixed model.
_field_help.demo: Set true to run the synthetic demo repository generation before analysis. This matches the --demo CLI flag.
_field_help.mixed_model_only: Set true to skip the state/correlation/matrix analyses and run only the main mixed-model branch from the cache. This matches the --mixed-model-only CLI flag.
_field_help.plots_only: Set true to reuse the saved source/results caches and only generate figures, without rewriting CSV, JSON, or the analysis report. This matches a plots-only plotting pass.
